program:
move 10, R2

avg_loop:
    move    0, R0          # frequency
    move    0, R1          # step counter

    sub R0, 2000000000, R0
    
    reset_ph
    set_freq        R0
    upd_param       200

nco_set:
    set_freq        R0                           # Set the frequency
    add             R0, 20000000, R0  # Update the frequency register
    upd_param       200                          # Wait for time of flight
    acquire         0, R1, 16384
    add             R1, 1, R1
    nop
    jlt             R1, 200, @nco_set      # Loop over all frequencies

    loop            R2, @avg_loop

    stop                                  # Stop
